about: The date filter shown on each Datafy dashboard for one download, for exports whose file names carry no date range. Read by scripts/load_datafy_reports.py. 'added' is the Pacific date the files were added to the repository; the first entry whose 'added' date and 'match' pattern fit a file wins. A range typed into a file name (for example _01-01-2026_to_30-09-2026) overrides everything here, and from the next download on the file names carry the range, so no entry is needed.
